scripts.build: npm run build:clean && npm run build:lib && npm run build:vike && npm run build:server && npm run build:alias
scripts.build:lib: npm run build -w @qiln/core && npm run build -w @qiln/engine
scripts.server:dev:engine:watch: node scripts/wait-for.js packages/core/dist/sentinel.js && npm run dev --workspace=@qiln/engine
scripts.server:dev:compile: node scripts/wait-for.js packages/core/dist/.build-complete packages/engine/dist/.build-complete && nodemon --verbose --watch server --watch server/tsconfig.json --ext ts,json --ignore server/dist --exec "tsc --project ./server/tsconfig.json --incremental && tsc-alias -p ./server/tsconfig.json && node --import ./register.mjs dist/server/index.js"
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:server && npm run build:alias && node --import ./register.mjs dist/server/db/seed.js
scripts.db:reset: npm run build:server && npm run build:alias && node --import ./register.mjs dist/server/db/reset.js
scripts.db:rebuild: npm run db:reset && rimraf server/db/migrations && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.type:check:packages: npm run type:check -w @qiln/core && npm run type:check -w @qiln/engine
scripts.type:check: npm run type:check:packages && npm run type:check:app
